title: Generation container must extend or proxy Screen to preserve Promise<Screen> compatibility

anchor.contextBefore: export class Generation<TItem, TRaw = unknown> implements Iterable<TItem> {
anchor.targetSnippet: export class Generation<TItem, TRaw = unknown> implements Iterable<TItem> {

violation.problem: Generation is a standalone container with no inheritance or property forwarding to Screen. Callers expecting Promise<Screen> fail TypeScript compilation and runtime property accesses (e.g. screen.id, screen.title, screen.getHtml(), screen.edit()).
violation.expectedSolution: Make Generation extend Screen (or proxy Screen properties to this.first) so it is assignable to Screen and preserves 100% backward compatibility for single-screen consumers while offering .screens and iteration for multi-screen consumers.
